the use of EDTA in combination with other natural antimicrobial agents such as CEO and/or nisin can be considered as a promising approach to enhance the safety and shelf-life of vacuum packed cooked sausages.

natural antimicrobals can be used to extend shelf-life of vacuum packaged emulsion-type sausage, but the effect is dependent on type of antimicrobials and the combination used.
